From: Sara Connors <sara.connors@acme.ai>
To: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 08:12:00 -0500
Subject: Quick question — trial + walkthrough

Hi Redwood team,

I just signed up for a trial this morning (Acme AI) and wanted to see if someone could walk us through the first 30 minutes — basic onboarding, model selection guidance, and a short Q&A about VPC/private deployment. We're evaluating inference latency and cost for an upcoming pilot.

Our prefered window is next week in the afternoons PT (after 4pm PT). Happy to take a recorded walkthrough if live is tight.

A few notes:
- We're primarily interested in hosted API + Dedicated options
- Security/compliance will be important (SOC2, audit logs)

Thanks —
Sara Connors
Head of Product, Acme AI
Sara.Connors@acme.ai
(415) 555-0192
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Cc: michael.grant@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 03 Dec 2029 09:07:00 -0500
Subject: Re: Quick question — trial + walkthrough

Hi Sara — welcome and thanks for signing up!

I’m Monica on the SDR/Onboarding team — happy to set up a 30-minute session to cover exactly what you mentioned (model selection tips, latency/cost tradeoffs, and an intro to Private/Dedicated).

You can grab a slot that fits your afternoons-PT here: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min
(If you don’t see a time that works, reply with 2-3 windows and I’ll book manually.)

Quick intake — if you don’t mind filling this 1-page form it helps us tailor the call: https://drive.google.com/open?id=trial-intake-form (attached as trial-intake-form.pdf)

Plan for the call: 30 minutes — 15-minute demo, 10-minute tailoring to your use case, 5-minute next steps. I’ll include a short checklist for pre-demo items (API key, example prompt, any regulatory constraints).

If you'd rather I book something for you, tell me which days next week after 4pm PT work best and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks — looking forward to it.

—Monica
Monica Patel | Senior SDR, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

If you can book for us, our preferred windows next week are:
- Wed Dec 4 after 4pm PT (5pm PT is ideal)
- Thu Dec 5 after 4pm PT

We’ll likely have 2 people on the call (me + our infra lead, Paul Nguyen — paul.nguyen@acme.ai). Feel free to include any short pre-call notes in the invite.

On compliance: we’re starting with hosted API but will need to assess Private for production.

Best,
Sara
